## Strongest claim and exact scope

H6, SourceCurrentColdFiniteWarmCalls.constructed_node_calls, remains the
strongest end-to-end language theorem. A covered closed construction and valid
constraint-allocation history supply any prescribed finite NUMBER of modeled
node-processing rounds. Their actual finite trace completes at sufficient
fuel and one mathematical width selected after construction. The inherited
payload is empty. The final available value has exactly the initial finite-
tree language for every ambient context and term under Formula/Entailment.
It does not cover arbitrary mixed operations or the full recursive driver.

The new results cover the existing nonempty terminal producer: a first/rest
suspended bucket, nonempty closed available incoming value, genuine current
Context and cache invariants. They remove the full old range premise in favor
of initial Fits, a guard carrier and Reserved bits seed (bucket.length+1).
Both wrappers retain every earlier output receipt and add resource bounds at
their actual fold and final native endpoints. The terminal outer fallback,
whole-driver language and recursive completion remain separate obligations.
Concrete solver, physical-container and host-integer correspondence,
extraction, convergence and arbitrary lazy forcing also remain open.

## Compare exact successful phase returns

TerminalPrefix.run_unique takes two actual singleton observations from the
same first/rest, waiting map and input core at arbitrary representative fuel.
It identifies recorded roots, winner, moved waiting map and the ENTIRE joined
core. Private exactness lemmas turn actual successful scans and unions into
exact singleton executions. Existing Retains lemmas lift both actual successes
to max fuel. The exact singleton observations there identify every field.
No Safe, Total, Roots, pending, range or future-trace premise is required.
The theorem makes no equality claim for failed bounds.

Fold.ok_unique takes two actual outer .ok observations from the same flag,
source list, caller, core, target and query memo at arbitrary native/worker/
reader fuel. Dispatch.ok_unique identifies the captured action, full caller
and query memo. The SAME action has the SAME raw result. Only its successful
singleton continues recursively. Other raw shapes retain fixed endpoints.
The theorem covers none, rejection, inner errors and multiple rows. It retains
the full final caller, saved queries and outer core. No Context or range
premise is needed. Errors are not converted into successes.

## Derive the entire terminal range condition

CachedTerminalAdapter.observed_prefix invokes genuine Prefix.run_complete
from current invariants. Exact prefix uniqueness identifies its actual result
with an arbitrary supplied singleton observation. The recorded-root map,
PendingRealized, winner PendingAt and all recorded pending slots therefore
hold at that exact observed joined core. Its values match the original core;
its representatives may have changed. No joined Safe claim is needed.

CachedTerminalAdapter.initial_ranges takes current Context, Safe, roots,
waiting counts, bounded InputsPending, realized slots, closed available
incoming, Fits, guard carrier and the original mixed reservation. It does
not require expandable flags or an incoming suspended bucket just to derive
admission. Every actual successful prefix has original recorded length,
including duplicate roots and winner/no-op entries. The reservation's prefix
supplies the fold schedule, and Fold.initial_ranges supplies its ENTIRE old
future-universal admission predicate.

For EVERY actual successful singleton fold, the proof constructs the old
Fold.run_complete result from those same genuine inputs. Fold.ok_unique
identifies its complete caller and enumeration endpoint with the observation.
The actual endpoint therefore has full Post and PendingRealized. The actual
fold resource observer supplies Fits at advance seed recorded.length.
The original reservation has one remaining step at that entry. Full Post
retains incoming availability. IncomingNode.initial_ranges now derives the
following query's admission at that SAME actual fold return.

No future successful prefix, fold, cache or range receipt is an initial
producer premise. Those observations occur only inside the old quantified
range conclusion that the new admission theorem derives.

## Retain both complete terminal packets

CachedTerminal.complete_resources derives admission and invokes the old
complete producer ONCE. It retains the same witnesses and every output field.
Its actual prefix observation supplies joined facts. Its actual fold return
receives Fits and a guard carrier at advance seed (first::rest).length.
The recorded-root identity equates that count with the ORIGINAL bucket length.

If the fold rejects, the old rejection packet identifies the final caller
with the actual fold caller. Numeric and alphabet growth pad the unused
incoming step. No incoming execution is asserted. Completed prefix effects
and rejecting native effects remain present.

If the fold succeeds, the old completed packet contains the literal subsequent
IncomingNode.run observation. Current fold Post, realized slots, transported
incoming availability and the original last-step Room supply its resources.
These bounds concern the SAME final caller after the optional Empty check.
The old write prefix and intersection-language packet remain present too.
